desc: TekMat is the creator of original printed cleaning and maintenance mat. Their 17" TekMats are large enough to handle a fully disassembled handgun with room to spare for tools and accessories. The 1/8" padding on these mats not only provides a premium feel and high level of quality but it offers extra protection from any rough handling or drops while working on your firearm. The ultra soft, oil and water-resistant surface helps protect your firearm from scratches while the diagrams and illustrations help with cleaning, disassembly and are just plain fun to look at.
